name: Academy Press
source: Academy Press Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026, consolidated and separate statements of financial position (report page 27 of the annual report), GROUP column, N thousands, stored at full naira: total non-current assets 1,591,270, total current assets 1,720,680, total assets 3,311,950, total equity 920,764 (equity attributable to owners 1,059,569 less non-controlling interests 138,805), total liabilities 2,391,186. Ties: 1,591,270 plus 1,720,680 equals 3,311,950 and 3,311,950 less 920,764 equals 2,391,186, which is the total liabilities printed in the segment note. The March 2025 comparative in this report (total assets 3,794,066) differs from the figure already stored for FY2025 (3,628,389), which came from the prior year report; the stored FY2025 column was left as it was and only the FY2026 column was added. Non-current and current liabilities are not printed as subtotals on this page, so those two rows are left empty for FY2026 rather than derived.
note: Balance sheet checked against the accounting identity (assets = liabilities + equity). Rows computed from the period's own component rows or from the other two totals are marked derived; figures that could not be reconciled are withheld and listed in _balance_identity_withheld.json.

periodAlignment.note: this statement and its counterpart cover different periods; pair them by period label, never by array index (see bot/statements.py::pkey)

source_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-06: the previous file carried segment-note columns as if they were group totals (FY2025 total assets 3,208,709 and FY2024 80,378 were columns of the segment reconciliation, not the group statement of financial position). Replaced with the audited group figures from the consolidated statement of financial position, page 27 to 28, and the segment reconciliation on page 55, both of which print group total assets 3,628,389 for 2025 and 3,106,287 for 2024. The three older columns (FY2023, FY2022, FY2021) held the same segment columns and were dropped rather than carried, because no audited group figure was available to replace them. Units N'000. Non-current assets plus current assets equals total assets, non-current plus current liabilities equals total liabilities, and liabilities plus equity equals total assets, exactly, on both periods.
